title: U.S.–China Reciprocal Dependency and Substitution Map — 2026
adds: Not a scoreboard of import shares but product-specific dependencies with different owners, permissions and replacement clocks. China's strongest leverage is mid-chain (rare-earth separation/magnets, graphite/anodes, battery materials/cells, solar wafers/cells, shipyard scale, drone/electronics lower tiers); U.S.-plus-allies leverage is in frontier chips, EDA/equipment, aircraft engines/avionics/certification and market/dollar/regulatory permissions. Agriculture and hydrocarbons are large but weaker choke points. Qualification is the hidden clock; inventory buys time, not independence. Substitution bands S0-S4 are planning bands, not forecasts.
